Title: Query Rowan Ring Ghoul Retainer LSJ

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
In
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/3d6b8d38713c39ce
LSJ say's that ghoul retainer's weapon effect is not a trike, and is
thus not dodgeable.
This means Ghoul retainer on a minion, at close, is an undodgeable go
to torpor, correct?

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On May 18, 2:06 pm, Blooded Sand wrote:

> LSJ say's that ghoul retainer's weapon effect is not a trike, and is
> thus not dodgeable.

> This means Ghoul retainer on a minion, at close, is an undodgeable go
> to torpor, correct?

Your interrogative is missing vital information.

A minion that has a Rowan Ring and a Ghoul Retainer can have the Ghoul
use the Ring to send the opposing vampire to torpor (at close range).
That effect cannot be prevented by Strike:Dodge. That effect will be
prevented by Strike: Combat Ends.

See also:
Tariq Eats World
Muaziz Eats World

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.

It can also be thwarted by a strike to destroy (or steal) the Rowan
Ring at first strike (e.g., superior Canine Horde).
